figures.caption: TABLE I: Performance comparison of different loop invariant inference methods on the multi-loop benchmark. Numbers in parentheses denote the performance on the three data sources: OOPSLA-13, SV-COMP, and CLRS-Alg. INVWEAVER solves at least 32 more problems, and performs especially better on the more challenging CLRS-Alg problems.

TABLE II: Performance comparison of different loop invariant inference methods on the single-loop benchmark. Numbers in parentheses denote the performance on the three specific data sources: OOPSLA-13, SV-COMP, and CLRS-Alg. The proposed INVWEAVER solves 68 out of 70 problems, which is at least 19 more than the competitors.
